_doc: PR-B (2026-05-30) — user-facing strings for the 7-step Curator onboarding wizard. Loaded via TemplateManager.loadJson(ConfigTemplateId.Onboarding). Vocabulary contract: Profile→Provider, Quick→Fast Lookup, Deep→Research, Premium→Use stronger model when needed, Embedding→Knowledge Index, Web Search slot→Web Access, MCP Servers→External tools, Permission mode→Safety. Edit values freely; the wizard falls back to DEFAULT_ONBOARDING_STRINGS in src/ui/view/onboarding/onboardingStrings.ts if any key is missing.

welcome.description: We will look at your environment (RAM, installed Ollama, configured API keys, note language) and your preferences (budget, speed vs quality) to pick a model for Fast Lookup, Research, and the “stronger model when needed” tier. You can accept, edit, or redo at any time.
